title: BrowserPrimitiveCandidate
description: A candidate reusable primitive proposed from a browser_session_report by browser_report_to_primitive_candidates. Each is evidence-linked back to the CapturedArtifact source_hash it was derived from, carries a determinism level + a verifier plan + a risk score, and is born candidate=true, serves_truth=false — generation is not promotion. It becomes served truth only after source review + an executed passing proof + the gates.

schema_version.description: version lives in metadata, never in an id or name

source_session_id.description: the browser_session_report.session_id this candidate came from

evidence_refs.description: provenance back to the CapturedArtifact(s): always includes at least one source_hash

side_effects.description: side effects the primitive itself performs; read-only primitives are empty

determinism_level.description: D0 fully deterministic (classifiers/gates); D2 LLM-assisted with a deterministic fallback; higher = more model-dependent

fixtures.description: offline fixture handles that would verify this candidate (dom_hash / form action / download url) — digests, never raw bodies

verifier_plan.description: how a proof would exercise this candidate incl. a mutation gate + a determinism check

risk_score.description: 0 safe .. 1 high risk; regulated writes score highest
